appearances.snippet: In any case, just in case you are not understanding how much he adores and values his relationship with Erika (Erika Kirk) as a friend in his life, here is Blake Wynn. He did a podcast and he was speaking with this guy, Jeff Fargo. The podcast is called Fargo Talks, and here is what he had to say. ... I was with you at breakfast when I found out about Charlie Kirk being shot. And it's one of those things that separate from that situation, it's I've sort of asked myself, why was I with you? And you fit into a very small bucket of people that I have in my life where, you know, it's so easy to look up to people. And I've been very fortunate in my life to get to know.
